title: Gender-Neutral Rewriting in Italian: Models, Approaches, and Trade-offs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the ability of Large Language Models to perform Gender-Neutral Rewriting (GNR) on Italian text using the mGeNTE benchmark dataset. Gender neutrality is assessed via an LLM-as-a-judge binary classification approach, while semantic meaning preservation is measured using BERTScore and BARTScore.
